items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A dialog that asks the user to confirm or cancel

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person or entity shown as an image, initials or a placeholder

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact label for a status, category or count

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: An inline message with a status

items.name: baseui-constitution
items.title: baseui constitution
items.description: The design rules and the protocol for agents that build prototypes: warn in the answer and put a ConstitutionBanner across the top when a request breaks a rule. Point your AGENTS.md at it.

items.name: baseui-core
items.title: baseui core
items.description: The shared code every component imports: React access, describe(), theme flags, floating and highlight hooks, the icon weight rule.

items.name: baseui-icons
items.title: baseui icons
items.description: The icon catalog: outline (line) and filled (solid) bundles used by Icon.

items.name: baseui-styles
items.title: baseui styles
items.description: Tokens, component styles and the Tailwind v4 theme (tailwind.css). Import tokens.css and src/components.css once and set data-theme="light|dark" on <html>. Fonts: the tokens use Geist; load it yourself.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Links that show where the user is in a hierarchy

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Triggers an action or navigates. A label that does not fit in the width of the button is cut with an ellipsis, never wrapped

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Lays out the buttons of one decision: a row that wraps (horizontal) or a column in which every button fills the width (vertical). The layout is the group’s, so a button needs no width of its own

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for picking a date or a date range

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A container that groups related content

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A box that turns one option on or off, with an optional label. The error is text under the box: it has no outline

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: CheckboxGroup
items.description: A group of checkboxes: the value is an array of the checked `value`s. The error is a message under the group; the boxes do not turn red

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A section that expands and collapses

items.name: constitution-banner
items.title: ConstitutionBanner
items.description: A strip across the top of a prototype that warns it breaks the design constitution: which rules, where, and what each one asks for. It is not dismissible

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The dialog: a centered window on a wide screen and a bottom sheet on small ones, built on the Base UI Dialog. The sheet can be dragged down by its header to close. A control inside it with `data-dialog-close` (a Close or Done button) closes the dialog without wiring an onClick

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A line that separates content

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: A menu of options that opens from any trigger. Below 768px it is a bottom sheet, as the list of a Selector is. Above, it opens over the page (drawn in the body, flipped and kept on screen), so it never pushes the content or gets clipped by a scrolling container. It stands alone: Selector and Typeahead draw their lists with the same items, groups and dividers

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: The layout of a form: fields in rows with one gap in both directions, rows of one to four columns, and sections with a heading

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: An icon of the catalog. The outline icon has the standard stroke everywhere; `weight="auto"` makes it follow the text it stands next to

items.name: layout
items.title: Stack
items.description: A row of controls with one height, one text size and one icon size: the controls take the size of the row unless they have their own

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: A hyperlink in the color of the text, underlined by default

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: A vertical list of rows with an optional title and divider

items.name: mobile-navigation
items.title: Navbar
items.description: The bar at the top of a mobile screen: a back button on the left, the title in the middle and up to two icon actions on the right

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: A text input for numbers: a minus button first, the number in the middle, a plus button last. It takes the props of the Text Input (variant, status, caption, prefix, suffix, floatingLabel)

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OtpInput
items.description: A one-time code field. It checks the code through onComplete and shows the states of that check: verifying, error (the row shakes) and success. On enhanced animations the digits arrive with a short animation and the focus ring slides between the cells

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Navigation between pages. The number of items is always the same (the first and the last page, the current one with its neighbours, and a gap on each side), so nothing jumps; a gap is a button that jumps to the middle of the pages it hides, when the page changes; the arrows stay and are disabled at the ends. It can also move through the pages by itself

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A floating panel anchored to a trigger. It opens over the page (drawn in the body, flipped and kept on screen), so it never pushes the content or gets clipped by a scrolling container

items.name: product-card
items.title: ProductCard
items.description: The card of a product in a listing: a picture with a badge and a heart over it, the price, the title in two lines, the rating and one line of meta (for example how many were sold)

items.name: product-listing
items.title: ProductListing
items.description: A listing of products: the cards take the whole width of a row and the listing always shows whole rows. After the first rows come a "Show more" button (the default), an endless scroll or pagination, by setting

items.name: progress-bar
items.title: ProgressBar
items.description: A linear progress indicator

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: A radio button for a RadioGroup: it is checked by the group value, it has no `checked` of its own

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: A group of radio buttons: the value is the `value` of the selected option. The error is a message under the group; the circles do not turn red

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: Collects a rating as stars. Only whole values can be chosen

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: SegmentedControl
items.description: A control for switching between a few exclusive options

items.name: selector
items.title: Selector
items.description: A field, or any element, that opens a list of options: the Base UI Select in the shared field shell. Single and multiple selection; below 768px the list is a bottom sheet

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shown while content loads

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Selects a number in a range, or with `range` two numbers: a lower and an upper bound

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A loading indicator

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: Tells the user the state of a view: nothing to show, information, success, a warning or an error. It fills the container it is in, in width and height, and centers its content

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An instant on/off of an independent setting: a track, a thumb and an optional label. Several switches are independent boolean fields; to choose N of M use a Checkbox Group

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Tabular data with sorting, selection and several looks

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between related views: the row of tabs and the panel under it. A row wider than its container scrolls, with slide buttons and a fade at the edges from the lg breakpoint (1024px); below it the row is scrolled by touch or the wheel

items.name: template-ai-chat-conversation
items.title: AI Chat Conversation
items.description: A transcript of alternating turns with rich content inline, beside a panel that holds the generated result

items.name: template-ai-chat-landing
items.title: AI Chat Landing
items.description: The empty counterpart to a transcript: one composer in the middle and suggestion chips instead of history

items.name: template-analytics-dashboard
items.title: Analytics Dashboard
items.description: Three bands: headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all read from one filter bar. A summary surface rather than a drill-down

items.name: template-card-grid
items.title: Card Grid
items.description: A searchable grid of cards with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles, narrowing in place

items.name: template-centered-hero
items.title: Centered Hero
items.description: A symmetrical stack: headline, a short blurb and two actions, resting on one wide picture with nothing on the flanks

items.name: template-checkout-form
items.title: Checkout Form
items.description: A long sectioned form beside a summary that stays in view and recalculates as fields change

items.name: template-checkout-wizard
items.title: Checkout Wizard
items.description: Cart, order and payment as steps, with a running summary that recalculates and validation before every advance

items.name: template-classic-gallery
items.title: Classic Gallery
items.description: A uniform grid of equal-ratio tiles under a centered intro, with filters that narrow the set in place

items.name: template-collapsible-table
items.title: Collapsible Table
items.description: Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns, for groups that do not share a schema

items.name: template-comparison-table
items.title: Comparison Table
items.description: Candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column and the best value in each row marked

items.name: template-contact-form
items.title: Contact Form
items.description: A flat single-column form that mixes control types and ends on one full-width submit: no steps, no branching

items.name: template-data-dashboard
items.title: Data Dashboard
items.description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that carry a sparkline and period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns

items.name: template-dialog-wizard
items.title: Dialog Wizard
items.description: Two to four short steps in a dialog launched from the page, which stays where it was

items.name: template-documentation-catalog
items.title: Documentation Catalog
items.description: A reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards that link into sections

items.name: template-documentation-design
items.title: Documentation Design
items.description: An article that alternates prose with live examples: a preview, a property table, paired do and don’t comparisons and a code block

items.name: template-documentation-technical
items.title: Documentation Technical
items.description: A reference article in numbered steps with code at each stage, and callout cards for prerequisites and next links

items.name: template-executive-summary-dashboard
items.title: Executive Summary Dashboard
items.description: A report-shaped page: a scorecard of headline numbers with deltas and status colors, goal bars, a trend grid and a written commentary column

items.name: template-file-explorer
items.title: File Explorer
items.description: A folder tree beside a file list, with breadcrumbs, a list or grid switch and a details pane for the selected file

items.name: template-filterable-table
items.title: Filterable Table
items.description: Progressive filtering over a flat collection: filter chips that stack, a saved view and a detail panel for the selected row

items.name: template-form-wizard
items.title: Form Wizard
items.description: A linear form, one panel at a time, with a progress track above so every step keeps the full width; a step left broken stays flagged

items.name: template-funnel-cohort-dashboard
items.title: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
items.description: Analytics for sequence and retention: a staged funnel that reads as drop-off between steps, and a cohort matrix drawn as a heatmap

items.name: template-gallery-hero
items.title: Gallery Hero
items.description: The same centered stack, resolving into a grid of several pictures so the imagery reads as a set

items.name: template-grouped-table
items.title: Grouped Table
items.description: Rows bundled into collapsible sections with a count per group, so a long list reads as a few blocks

items.name: template-inbox-table
items.title: Inbox Table
items.description: A two-pane message queue: the list indexes a reading pane, and replying opens a composer that leaves the list live

items.name: template-inline-wizard
items.title: Inline Wizard
items.description: A short flow inside a card on the page: steps swap in place, without a dialog or a new page

items.name: template-kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: Columns of cards by stage, with a count per column, avatars and labels on every card

items.name: template-login-card
items.title: Login Card
items.description: A centered card with email and password, a remembered-device switch and one primary action

items.name: template-login-split
items.title: Login Split
items.description: A sign-in form on one half and a picture with a short promise on the other

items.name: template-login-sso
items.title: Login SSO
items.description: Sign-in through identity providers first, with the password form folded under a divider

items.name: template-mixed-gallery
items.title: Mixed Gallery
items.description: Tiles of different heights packed in columns, like a masonry wall, with a filter row above

items.name: template-order-detail
items.title: Order Detail
items.description: One order in full: its status and timeline, the items, the totals, the addresses and the actions that are still possible

items.name: template-portfolio-dashboard
items.title: Portfolio Dashboard
items.description: Holdings at a glance: total value, an allocation breakdown, a performance line and a sortable table of positions

items.name: template-product-detail
items.title: Product Detail
items.description: A product page: gallery, price, options, an add-to-cart action, details in tabs and a rating summary

items.name: template-product-gallery
items.title: Product Gallery
items.description: A storefront grid: product cards with price, badge and a rating, sorted and filtered from a toolbar

items.name: template-project-status-dashboard
items.title: Project Status Dashboard
items.description: Where every project stands: health by status, progress against milestones, who is blocked and what ships next

items.name: template-searchable-table
items.title: Searchable Table
items.description: A flat collection with one search field above it: results narrow as you type, with an empty state when nothing matches

items.name: template-service-monitoring-dashboard
items.title: Service Monitoring Dashboard
items.description: Uptime and latency for a set of services: a status grid, response time charts, an incident banner and a list of recent events

items.name: template-settings-dialog
items.title: Settings Dialog
items.description: Preferences in a dialog with tabs, opened from the page and closed without losing the place underneath

items.name: template-settings-form
items.title: Settings Form
items.description: One long settings page of sections, each with its fields, and a single save row that stays within reach

items.name: template-settings-panels
items.title: Settings Panels
items.description: Settings split into panels: a list of areas on the left and the chosen area on the right, saved as you go

items.name: template-shell-nav
items.title: Shell Nav
items.description: The frame in both shapes: a top bar on a narrow screen and a side column on a wide one, from the same destinations

items.name: template-side-gallery
items.title: Side Gallery
items.description: A filter column on the side and a result grid beside it, with a count and a sort control above the grid

items.name: template-side-nav
items.title: Side Nav
items.description: An application frame with a collapsible side navigation of sections and a page area beside it

items.name: template-top-nav
items.title: Top Nav
items.description: An application frame with a top bar of destinations, an account menu and a page area below

items.name: template-two-column-form
items.title: Two-column Form
items.description: Fields that belong together sit side by side, with a section title for each group and one action row at the end

items.name: template-vertical-wizard
items.title: Vertical Wizard
items.description: Steps listed down the side with the current panel beside them: completed steps stay reachable, the rest are locked

items.name: template-work-item-detail
items.title: Work Item Detail
items.description: A ticket page: title, description, activity with comments, and a side column of status, assignee, labels and dates

items.name: text-input
items.title: TextInput
items.description: A single-line or multi-line text field with a floating label, built on the Base UI Input

items.name: toast
items.title: ToastProvider
items.description: Shows brief notifications: a message, an optional action and a close button. Call `useToast()` to add one

items.name: token
items.title: Token
items.description: A chip for selection or indication: a Base UI Toggle with a size, a status and slots. With `action` it is a button, removable or plain

items.name: token-group
items.title: TokenGroup
items.description: A group of chips: a title, a wrapping container and a caption or an error. With `options` a managed set (the value is an array of the selected values), with `children` a free layout

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or focus. It is never shown on a touch screen (no hover there), so keep the information available some other way

items.name: typeahead
items.title: Typeahead
items.description: A text field that suggests options as you type: the Base UI Combobox in the shared field shell. The typed text and the selected value are separate states. Below 768px the list is a bottom sheet with a search
